assets.subject: Old Peatfire creature concept
assets.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL creature concept for Whetstorm, a vibrant stylized fantasy MMORPG. One single full-body character on a perfectly plain white background, centered, facing directly forward in a neutral T-pose, arms out horizontally, hands fully visible, feet fully visible, short heavy tail visible in silhouette. This is Old Peatfire: a hulking ancient bipedal dragon-kin with broad heavy shoulders, thick clawed hands and feet, cracked bark-brown peat-like scales with restrained moss-green patches, subtle ember-orange fissures and a trace of smoke curling from its jaws. The silhouette must be simple, powerful and readable at a distance; use broad graphic forms and a clean, cohesive hand-painted fantasy game concept style with lush but controlled color and moderate detail. Avoid photorealism, noisy textures, elaborate ornament and cinematic scenery. Design the anatomy so a 3D artist could understand it. No text, no logo, no border, no props, no weapons, no other characters, no cast shadow. Entire body must fit with generous white margin. Do not copy any existing character, franchise or game asset.
assets.status: concept for review; not a 3D model
